title: Good: response body size limits enforced during streaming not post-buffer
description: kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs applies http_body_util::Limited at the body-streaming layer before JSON parsing. STATUS_MAX_BYTES=10MiB is justified (large tailnets with many peer entries) and documented. WHOIS_MAX_BYTES=100KiB is documented with the real response size (1-2KiB). A contributor might remove these limits for simplicity or raise them without justification. The limits should stay: tailscaled is local but its response is untrusted bytes; unbounded allocation before JSON parsing is a DoS vector if tailscaled is compromised or replaced.
